Instead, average employer-sponsored family health insurance premiums have risen 26% since 2020. 💰 He promised to bring down the national debt. Instead, U.S. debt has now surpassed $40 trillion, while debt held by the public is approaching levels not seen since the aftermath of World War II. These are just a few of the promises Trump made.
